verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships an official CLI built for non-interactive use. `--json` mode puts structured results on stdout and errors on stderr, with distinct exit codes. Hands-on keyless probes show offline commands (understand, assess, validate, doctor) running non-interactively. However, hosted process functions require a device-code login that stops at a human approval step, and nothing documents a CI or service credential. missing for 10: documented non-interactive or CI authentication (API token or env-var credential), CI pipeline usage docs or examples, independent corroboration of authenticated headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With `--json`, the agent gets the link and controls completion without an interactive prompt.
Successful results appear on stdout as a `schemaVersion` and `data` object. Errors appear on stderr as a `schemaVersion` and `error` object
`$ ultrametric understand --json` → a complete company-profile guide (kind "company_profile_guide": instructions, template, result schema, agent-trial spec), offline, exit 0
A device-code login an agent can drive end to end up to the human approval step
